items.prompt: A function returns one price line from an eligible fill tape. How does that differ from slice_order?

options.text: A realized price benchmark versus target share quantities.
options.why: Their units, inputs and output roles differ even though both involve weights.

options.text: Both return an identical chronological share schedule.
options.why: A price benchmark does not allocate a parent share total.

options.text: VWAP must sum to the parent order size.
options.why: A price has no share-conservation total.

options.text: slice_order proves the future VWAP price.
options.why: Target allocation alone does not predict or confirm actual execution prices.
